en: Colorized historic view of a landscaped garden with a circular flowerbed in the foreground and a busy city street behind it. People walk along paths and sidewalks, and several multi‑story buildings, including a hotel, line the street. Smoke stacks and a church‑like building with a red roof and tower are visible in the background. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Chemnitz." on the left and "Albertstrasse. Anlagen am Bahnhof." on the right.
